name: Parsley
botanicalTarget: Curly-leaf parsley matching native curly anatomy; divided ruffled leaf tufts, no flowers.

name: Sage
botanicalTarget: Broad velvety gray-green leaves and violet two-lipped flowers.

name: Oregano
botanicalTarget: Small opposite oval leaves, branching stems, pink-purple terminal flowers.

name: Strawberry
botanicalTarget: Trifoliate serrated leaves, five-petal white flowers, attached green and red berries.

name: Jalapeno
botanicalTarget: Smooth entire pointed leaves, white flowers, attached blunt green/red peppers.
